items.title: What Happened to Parametricism? How a Style Blurred Into a Look

items.title: Oslo Houses / Nommo Arquitetos
items.summary: Color does not belong to things; it does not exist on its own, but rather emerges from the encounter between light, matter, and the human gaze. It is a perception, a sensory experience capable of changing how we read the world and space.
